profile.name: Asadkhon Rasulov
profile.headline:
Building useful things.
Making room for curiosity.
profile.intro: I'm Asadkhon, a Computer Science graduate from the University of Arizona. I build web experiences, explore games, and enjoy helping others learn how things work.
profile.about:
My work connects software development, interactive experiences, and education. Alongside my degree, I supported Computer Organization and Calculus II students, helped organize HackAZ, and contributed to IT Park’s Local2Global project.

I’m building on that foundation through hands-on projects in web and game development.
